design_description: The Payicos FC jersey uses a refined emerald/forest-green and metallic gold palette, giving the kit a premium, traditional club identity. The body features a subtle vertical tonal transition, beginning in deep forest green around the shoulders and chest and becoming brighter toward the lower torso. Thin gold piping runs vertically along both sides, framing the central body and adding structure without introducing a heavy graphic pattern. Gold is used consistently for the key identity elements: the Payicos FC crowned deer crest, Momuto branding, main Rivulis sponsor and the secondary sponsors positioned near the lower front. The collar is dark green with a very fine gold edge, maintaining the understated premium treatment. The sleeves remain predominantly green and carry additional sponsor patches, while the otherwise clean construction keeps the attention on the club crest and commercial partners. Overall, it is a minimal, elegant and sponsor-led design: rich green as the foundation, controlled gold detailing, subtle tonal depth, and precise piping rather than an elaborate graphic pattern.
